Status.description:
The status of the asynchronous job. Valid values:  

- QUEUING: The job is queued.  

- PROCESSING: The job is being processed asynchronously.  

- PROCESS_SUCCESS: The job is processed successfully.  

- PROCESS_FAILED: The job failed to be processed.  

- TIMEOUT_FAILED: The job timed out before processing was completed.  

- LIMIT_RETRY_FAILED: The maximum retry count was exceeded.

ErrorMessage.description: The error message corresponding to the error code of the asynchronous job.

Result.description: The actual request result returned by the asynchronous job.

ErrorCode.description: The error code of the asynchronous job.

GetAsyncJobResult.title: Query Asynchronous Job Result
GetAsyncJobResult.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the GetAsyncJobResult API operation for querying asynchronous job results.
GetAsyncJobResult.description:
## Feature Description  
After you invoke an asynchronous API operation, the response does not contain the actual request result. You must save the request ID from the response and then call GetAsyncJobResult to obtain the actual request result.  

> - Files used in asynchronous jobs have a validity period of 30 minutes. To retain the files for a longer duration, download them to your local server or store them in OSS in a timely manner. For more information about OSS operations, see [Upload Objects](~~31886~~).  
- For assistance with accessing Visual Intelligence API operations of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, using API operations, or other inquiries, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

All API operations under the video segmentation category are asynchronous and require you to call GetAsyncJobResult to retrieve the actual request results.
GetAsyncJobResult.responseParamsDescription:
## SDK Reference  
We recommend that you use a software development kit (SDK) to call Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API operations. The SDK supports multiple programming languages and allows you to pass local files or any URL as file parameters. For more information, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
GetAsyncJobResult.extraInfo:
## Result Deserialization  
The preceding Result is deserialized and displayed as follows.  
```
{
	"VideoUrl": "http://algo-app-aic-vd-cn-shanghai-prod.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/video-human-segmentation/9CDE688A-8FC8-4B8D-8C34-1C3490703F23.mp4?Expires=1585193584&OSSAccessKeyId=LTAI4FoLmvQ9urWXgSRp****&Signature=z6DQV%2F14CFvammxkgXLcYm0wsW****"
}
```


## Error Code  
For error codes related to querying asynchronous task results, see [Common Error Codes](~~159108~~).

## Security Statement  
- You must ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during debug experience have a validity period of 1 hour and are automatically cleaned up and deleted by the system after 24 hours.

schema.description: The video URL. We recommend using an OSS link from the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or via OSS links from regions other than Shanghai, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).

VideoUrl.description:
The URL address of the output video.  
> This URL is temporary and has a validity period of 30 minutes. It will expire and become inaccessible afterward. If you need to retain the file for a longer duration or permanently, access the URL and download the file within 30 minutes, then store it in your own OSS bucket or other storage space.

SegmentVideoBody.title: Video Portrait Segmentation
SegmentVideoBody.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the SegmentVideoBody operation for video portrait segmentation.
SegmentVideoBody.description:
## Feature Description  
The video portrait segmentation feature parses the input video and returns the mask of the human region as a video sequence.  

> - You can obtain online assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
> - This feature is available for a complete free trial on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=videoseg&children=SegmentVideoBody) to experience this feature interactively or purchase it online.  
> - For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Create Account** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Enable the feature**: Ensure that you have enabled the [Video Segmentation Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/videoseg). If not, [enable it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_videoseg_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/videoseg/2020-03-20/SegmentVideoBody?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22VideoUrl%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fvideoseg%2FSegmentVideoBody%2FSegmentVideoBody1.mp4%22%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug the feature online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred programming language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - Install the SDK package under the video segmentation (videoseg) category in the corresponding language’s SDK documentation.  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the sample code provided in the documentation.  
6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages for this feature, see [Video Portrait Segmentation Sample Code](~~610206~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results in common languages, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  
7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation of this feature include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  
- **Video formats**: MP4, AVI, FLV, MOV.  
- **Video size**: No larger than 1 GB.  
- **Total frames**: Must not exceed 2000 frames.  
- **URL requirements**: The URL must not contain Chinese characters.  

## Security Statement  
- Ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during testing and debugging expire after 1 hour and are automatically deleted by the system after 24 hours.  

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of video portrait segmentation, see [Billing Introduction](~~202488~~).  

> The debugging API below is a paid API.  

## Invocation Steps  
This feature is asynchronous and requires two-step invocation:  

1. Call the SegmentVideoBody API to commit a job. Upon a successful request, you receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. Avoid resubmitting the same job while it is still processing.
SegmentVideoBody.responseParamsDescription:
## Query Result  
This API is asynchronous and does not return the actual request result immediately. You must use the returned RequestId to invoke the GetAsyncJobResult API to obtain the real request result. For more information, see [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~).

## SDK Reference  
We recommend that you use a software development kit (SDK) to invoke the video portrait segmentation capability under the video segmentation category of Alibaba Cloud Vision AI. The SDK supports multiple programming languages. When invoking the SDK, select the SDK package with the AI category set to video segmentation (videoseg). The file parameter supports both local files and arbitrary URLs when passed through the SDK. For more information, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).

## Sample Code  
For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this capability, see [Video Portrait Segmentation Sample Code](~~610206~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results in commonly used programming languages, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).
